product_metadata.title: Adhesive Oval Bath Treads - Purple
features: Improve the safety of your tub or shower.
Easy to install, just peel and stick.
Each package contains 21 Oval tread pieces.
Designed for use on smooth surfaces. Some surface textures may affect adhesion.
description: Say goodbye to boring bath stickers and long adhesive strips. Our Oval Multi-Piece Adhesive Treads come in a wide variety of shapes, sizes and colors - all designed to help you express yourself while you enhance the safety of your home’s most slippery surfaces. Mix, match, and make a masterpiece! Every package contains 21 durable, reliable vinyl treads! Durable for long-lasting, non-slip safety. Designed for use on smooth surfaces. Some surface textures may affect adhesion.
